cohort: Pregnant Wistar rats and their offspring.
finding: Advanced skull bone fusions observed in pregabalin-treated rats were reclassified as anatomic variations rather than malformations, concluding that pregabalin was not teratogenic under the study conditions.
cross-section timing: Gestation day/Postmating day (PMD) 21; PMD 20-25 and PMD 21-23
gest_age: Approximate birth on PMD 22 (full term for rats)
